text: The old pumpkin stander was at our house. I think we can weather school with a dance to jig you if I hadn't put on sweet hour of prayer. It played some grand opera in music that Hank Weaver said was just as good as it crept to Europe. It played silver threads among the gold and it had the women folk pretty night crying. It sounded too sad and pretty, I come darn near blubbering right out. We started up with a telephone and played jazz music
